patthana21.39:1.1: Nahetuṃ nasahetukaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu ahetuko sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.39:2.1: Nahetuṃ naahetukaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu ahetuko sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ. Gaṇitakena tīṇi.
patthana21.39:3.1: Nahetuṃ nasahetukaṃ naanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca… tīṇiyeva.
patthana21.39:4.1: Nahetuṃ nasahetukaṃ naanidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu ahetuko anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
